title: Why I love my job
instructions: Hemşire Laura işini anlatıyor. İyi ve zor yanlarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I've been a nurse at a children's hospital for six years.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I love my job because I can help children feel better.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The hardest part is working at night. I often work three nights a week.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But when a child goes home healthy, it makes everything worth it.
